method.metric: process.cpuUsage() user+system (primary); wall clock, maxRSS, log bytes (auxiliary)
method.isolation: one independent child process per round x side x sample; A,B,A-control alternated; identical frozen signed log + applied map read by both sides
method.A: baseline lib/ tree from git archive at --base
method.control: A-control is a second baseline run in the same round to bound noise
method.harness: module import and fixture read outside the timed window; 2 warmups; --expose-gc; --max-old-space-size=4096 inherited via NODE_OPTIONS
